chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from one of his companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) used to wear a white quilted cap, and he used to wear in battle a cap that had two ear-coverings.
ai.seo_question: What type of headgear did the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) wear during battle?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi highlights the Prophet’s (peace be upon him) adherence to the Sunnah of wearing a white quilted cap (qalansawah), a garment often associated with dignity and purity in early Islamic culture. The distinction between his daily attire and the specialized cap with ear coverings worn in battle underscores the practical wisdom (hikmah) of adapting clothing to specific contexts, a principle highly valued in Shia jurisprudence for deriving legal rulings on modesty and utility.
